name: @mailwoman/neural-weights-cjk
description: Mailwoman neural-classifier weights for CJK scripts — the char-path base model (Japanese + Chinese under one head). Data-only package: model.onnx + char-vocab.json + model-card.json, no SentencePiece tokenizer. Loaded by @mailwoman/neural at runtime. 0.0.1 is a NAME RESERVATION; the first functional release ships with the next mailwoman minor.
